description: This file provides support for OVHCloud AI Endpoints' chat completion API, implementing configuration, request transformation, and streaming response handling class tailored for OVHCloud's API that follows the OpenAI standard.

classes.name: OVHCloudChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OVHCloud chat API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig, providing methods for supported parameters, URL construction, error mapping, and request transformation.

classes.name: OVHCloudChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming responses from OVHCloud chat API, parsing chunks of streamed data and managing errors.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns supported OpenAI parameters for a given model, removing 'tools', 'tool_choice', 'function_call', and 'response_format' if model doesn't support function calling.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for a chat completion request.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an OVHCloudException instance for API errors.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and filters OpenAI parameters, extending super class method.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms and prepares the request payload, incorporating extra body data.

methods.name: ModelResponseStream chunk_parser(self, chunk: dict)
methods.description: Parses individual streaming response chunks, handling errors, and extracting choices.
